يمتلكوا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَلِكُوا (yamtalikū) /jam.ta.li.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# يُمْتَلَكُوا (yumtalakū) /jum.ta.la.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
